title: Honey and Mint Sausage Hotpot
ingredients: 8 reduced-fat pork sausages, each cut into 6
large handful of mint leaves (about 20g), finely chopped, plus extra to serve
450g (1lb) baby potatoes, halved, or quartered if large
300g (10.5oz) carrots, peeled and cut into matchsticks
method: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan (425°F), Gas Mark 7.
Spray a flameproof casserole dish with oil and fry the onion and sausage pieces over a high heat for 5 minutes, constantly stirring.
Add the garlic, mint, vinegar, honey and soy sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Pour in the hot stock, stir, then add the mustard and tomato purée.
Add the potatoes and carrots, season with salt and pepper, bring to the boil, then transfer to the middle shelf of the oven (uncovered) and cook for 40 minutes.
Give everything in the pot a thorough stir, then serve with mint scattered over the top.
notes: You could replace the potatoes with butternut squash or sweet potato, or add mushrooms. For veggie sausages, fry the onion on its own in step 2, then add sausage pieces in step 3 with the garlic.
